scaled_small_mapf.description: Scaled MAPF reproduction of the paper's central Fig. 2 claim: Real-Time LaCAM should retain full-horizon LaCAM success under tiny per-iteration planning budgets, while naive real-time replanning can fail.

success_rate.description: Fraction of expected slice instances solved with legal paths that end at the goals.

valid_rate.description: Fraction of expected slice instances with collision-free, legal joint paths.

coverage_rate.description: Fraction of expected slice instances represented by an artifact result, penalizing selective omission of hard cases.

mean_normalized_cost.description: Mean solved-path cost divided by the independent-agent shortest-path lower bound.

mean_expansions.description: Hardware-independent search effort reported as node expansions per represented slice instance.

duplicate_results.description: Number of duplicate result rows for expected slice instances, catching artifact padding or cherry-picking.

instances.description: Number of expected instances in this evaluation slice; included for auditability, not ranking.
